BoldReports._AdminPassword_comment: Set via BOLD_REPORTS_PASSWORD env var or 'dotnet user-secrets set BoldReports:AdminPassword ...'.
BoldReports._EmbedSecret_comment: Set via BOLD_REPORTS_SECRET env var or 'dotnet user-secrets set BoldReports:EmbedSecret ...'.

BoldBI._AdminPassword_comment: Set via BOLD_BI_PASSWORD env var or user-secrets. Must be distinct from BoldReports.
BoldBI._EmbedSecret_comment: Set via BOLD_BI_SECRET env var or user-secrets. Must be distinct from BoldReports.
